lines.text: Chapter 9: Peer Review. A letter on very good paper, with a very long footnote.
The Ostrander Institute has mislaid a building.
How do you mislay a building?
They call it the Annex. It's not on any of their plans, but it's still getting a power bill.
One professor. She stopped answering emails last spring. Now she only sends them back, corrected.
I had a teacher like that.
